seo.metaDescription: The fastest way to go from database to dashboards: a clean UI that won't scare off your teammates, governance so things don't go wrong, and SQL whenever you need it.

sections.heading: The fastest way to go from database to dashboards
sections.sub: A clean UI that won't scare off your teammates, governance so things don't go wrong, and SQL when you need it.
sections.mediaLabel: A Metabase dashboard of business metrics

pillars.title: Quick to set up
pillars.body: Skip the ETL and the modelling layer to begin with. Layer in structure later.

pillars.title: Self-host or deploy on Metabase Cloud
pillars.body: Go hands-free on our cloud, run it on your own hardware, or air-gap it entirely.

pillars.title: Secure data sharing
pillars.body: Share a dashboard with the whole company, or one row with one customer.

sections.heading: You could be querying 5 minutes from now
sections.lede: Regardless of what state your DB is in.
sections.mediaLabel: Building a question in the visual query builder
sections.caption: Watch how quick and easy it is to go from zero to chart

bullets.title: Low-lift to get started
bullets.body: Write your config up in a single YAML file, or tidy away things like experimental column headers right in the admin UI.

bullets.title: Curate what you expose
bullets.body: Choose the tables people see and edit their metadata in the UI, so self-service answers come out right.

bullets.title: Start simple before your first data hire joins the team
bullets.body: Add modelling layers as the data grows and more data-focused people come onboard.

sections.heading: Avoid repeated requests with reports anyone can run
sections.sub: Let people dive deeper into data on their own without the hand-holding.
sections.mediaLabel: A dashboard being filtered through a drill-through menu

items.title: Ask Metabot AI
items.body: Chat with your database to get answers in natural language, so the people who need a number can go and get it themselves.

items.title: Click on charts to drill into data
items.body: Drill-through menus answer the next question before it is asked — “can we see this broken down by plan?” — without anybody writing a query for it.

items.title: Query data with or without SQL
items.body: Put queries together intuitively in the visual query builder without writing any SQL, then drop into the editor when a question earns it.

items.title: Make content trustworthy and easy to find
items.body: Mark dashboards, models, metrics and questions as official, and keep everything else organised in collections.

items.title: Put the most valuable data in front of people
items.body: Schedule reports out to anyone, inside the organisation or outside it, over Slack or email.

sections.heading: Make sure people only see what they need to
sections.lede: Granular permissions keep people safe from accidentally seeing — or breaking — data that was never theirs to touch.
sections.mediaLabel: Setting table, row and column permissions for a group

bullets.title: Limit access at the table, row or column level
bullets.body: Lock down the sensitive tables, fields and columns while people carry on using the rest of the data.

bullets.title: Manage role-based permissions with SSO
bullets.body: Set visibility by role — marketing sees one thing, support another — with view and edit granted separately.

bullets.title: Keep track of who's doing what, when
bullets.body: Set alerts on access and downloads, and read the rest back out of usage analytics.

sections.heading: Works with your stack for live visualizations and reports, not extracts

__subRich.t: Metabase is a visualization and querying layer that sits on top of the database you already run, across
, so the numbers people read are the numbers that are in there right now — not the ones that were true when last night's export finished.
